summary_en: The video provides a detailed cooking tutorial for spicy beef macaroni soup in a modern studio kitchen. The hosts introduce ingredients, slice beef and vegetables, sear the beef, sauté aromatics in a glass pot, season the kimchi hot pot broth, add pasta and vegetables, and complete the dish before displaying the recipe card.
